title: IFS-based MODELS
description: Schema for the MODEL section of the workflow for IFS-based models

NAME.description: Name of the model to run the simulation.

ROOT_PATH.description: Path to the root of the model directory where the different models and there different versions are stored by default.

PATH.description: Path to the model directory, where the version of the model that you will use is/will be stored.

INPUTS.description: Path to the directory where the input files are stored.

COMPILE.description: If the model will be compiled before running it.

DVC_INPUTS_BRANCH.description: Branch of the DVC repository where the input files are stored.

USE_FIXED_DVC_COMMIT.description: If set to true, the version used is the one pinned as a submodule by the workflow. If set to false, the value of MODEL.DVC_INPUTS_BRANCH (branch or commit) is checked out in the local setup.

RESTARTS_FROM_PATH.description: Path to the directory where the restart files from a previous simulation are stored.

BUNDLE_BUILD_DIR.description: Path to the directory where the IFS/NEMO bundle is or will be built.

BUNDLE_SOURCE_DIR.description: Path to the directory where the IFS/NEMO bundle source code is stored.

FDB_DIRS.description: Path to the directory of the native, healpix and latlon FDB.

ICMCL_PATTERN.description: Pattern to search for the ICMCL files.

RAPS.description: RAPS flags to be used in the simulation.

GENERAL_FLAGS.description: Generic flags used in RAPS. Include --ifs-bundle-build-dir, --icmcl. -R, --deep

RESTART_FLAGS.description: Flags for the restart files. Include --restartdirectory, --keeprestart.

IO_FLAGS.description: Flags to control the I/O. Include --keepnetcdf --nextgemsout=6 --wam-multio --ifs-multio
